course.learn: This section focuses on **Motivations** within **Motivations**. Motivation explains what the attacker wants: financial gain, espionage, ideology, disruption, revenge, blackmail, data theft, or strategic advantage.
course.why: Motivation often predicts target selection and the behavior an organization should expect after compromise.
course.example: An extortion group steals data before encrypting systems so it can threaten publication if the victim refuses to pay.
course.exam: CompTIA frequently gives motive clues. Follow the goal to identify the actor or attack pattern.
